full_judgment: 6. Mr. Ahsanul Kabir, the learned Advocate appearing for the appellants has first urged that the judgment of the court of appeal below is not a proper judgment of reversal inasmuch as the learned Subordinate Judge did not consider the question of possession which is an important factor raising a presumption of benami.
